ko: 주 안에 우린 하나 모습은 달라도
en: In Jesus even if we look different we hope Jesus only
With love and good will, we encourage together We'll embrace one another
Jesus' in our hearts We feel our joy and sorrow together
I see Jesus inside of me And He is glad
Things Jesus planned through us Praise him with our imperfect lips
Things Jesus planned through us We wait for the work He'll do through you

ko: 나의 사랑 너는 어여쁘고 참 귀하다
en: My love, you are precious and adored in my sight
You are more beloved than any jewel
Even when you fail me I have loved you always with my unfailing love and I have come to you just to be with you

ko: 주의 사랑 이 사랑은 결코 변치 않아
en: Your love, abiding love never changes
Your care is present in all seasons
Here the grass withers and all the flowers fade
But Your word remains You make no mistakes, I look to You, my Lord
Let Your kingdom come and Your will come into my life and be done I want to know Your, I want to see Your, Lord, my God
Grant me strength to live in holiness and live a life of faith without fear Lord, You are my God, I will sing of Your perfect love
Things Jesus planned through us We wait for the work He'll do through you

ko: 주가 보이신 생명의 길 나 주님과 함께
상한 맘을 드리며 주님 앞에 나아가리
en: The Lord has shown me the way, so I’m walking with Him now He has embraced me when I came to Him with my broken heart

ko: 나의 의로움이 되신 주 그 이름 예수
en: He is my righteousness, Jesus is His name
He is the Way that I take, Jesus is the Name
He alone knows the way I take When He has tried me, I shall come for thas pure gold.

ko: 내가 이 자리에 선 것도 주의 부르심이라
en: For the calling of God is irrevocable,
There’s no taking back or change I believe it’s the Lord who called me here, For His own purpose and grace
There’s no error or a mistake I believe in God who’s faithful He’s the one Who has called me

ko: 작은 나를 부르신 뜻을 나는 알 수 없지만
오직 감사와 순종으로 주의 길을 가리라
en: I don’t know why He has called me, but He’s my God and Lord with a grateful heart I must follow Him
To the end in this narrow path

ko: 때론 내가 연약해져도 주님 날 도우시니
주의 놀라운 그 계획을 나는 믿으며 살리
en: When the trials come my way again He’s my help and I don’t fear God’s will and purpose surely will be
completed when I believe

ko: 날 부르신 뜻 내 생각보다 크고
날 향한 계획 나의 지혜로 측량 못하나
en: God’s purpose in my life is much greater than my thoughts The plans God has for me is amazing beyond any measure

ko: 가장 좋은 길로 가장 완전한 길로
en: I believe my God, my heavenly Father will Lead me on today to His perfect way

ko: 다 와서 찬양해 사랑을 주신 주 찬양해
en: Come, everyone, and praise the Lord who gave His love Our Lord of love has given life to us

ko: 소리쳐 찬양해 기쁨을 주시는 우리 왕
en: Lift your voice and sing His praise, our King who gives us joy With a sacrifice of praise we bow in worship

ko: 다 와서 찬양해 찬양해 찬양해 주님
en: Come and praise, praise,
Praise the Lord, our King

ko: 우리 함께 모여 주의 이름 찬양
en: Let us come together, sing praise to His name,
Let us lift our voices, calling on the Lord

ko: 위대한 일 행하셨네 우리 소망 충만해
우리 함께 모여 주의 이름 찬양
en: He has done great things for us,
Now our hearts are filled with hope
Let us come together, sing praise to His name
Jesus, the Living Lord
Even now, He moves with power
The One who conquered death
He broke the chains of the grave
We who once were lost in darkness
Are now called into His light
Hallelujah, Jesus is alive!
There is no one who compares to Him
Hallelujah, the Risen Lamb of God
Forever I will sing His praise
Jesus, the Living Lord
He reigns over all creation
Honor, glory, and power
To the Risen King we bring
We who once were lost in darkness
Are now called into His light
Hallelujah, Jesus is alive!
There is no one who compares to Him
Hallelujah, the Risen Lamb of God
Forever I will sing His praise
The Risen Lord, the Prince of Life gives me victory in my days I will praise You
Hallelujah, the Risen Lamb of God Forever I will sing Your praise Forever I will worship You
Hallelujah, Hallelujah, Hallelujah!
To You belongs all praise and glory

ko: 예수 우리 왕이여 이 곳에 오셔서
en: Jesus, we enthrone You We proclaim You are King
Standing here, in the midst of us We raise You up with our praise
And as we worship, build Your throne
Come Lord
Jesus, and take Your place
